exact.Hii ni safari ya ofa: muulize abiria PIN: This is an offer ride: ask the passenger for their PIN and start it in NAYA so NAYA pays you its part.
exact.wa NAYA: kofia mbili, bei ya app tu, kua: of NAYA: two helmets, app price only, starting and ending trips in the app, and the monthly fee.
exact.Ramani ya moja kwa moja, muda wa kufika,: Live map, arrival time, and trip sharing with family for your safety.
exact.Ofa za NAYA ni kwa wateja tu. Akaunti hi: NAYA offers are for passengers only. This account is registered as a driver, so it does not get offers.
exact.Umeshatumia safari zako zote za ofa. Asa: You have used all your offer rides. Thank you for riding with NAYA!
